data_source.method: Per-building polygon download via DuckDB+spatial+httpfs query on the Overture parquet release filtered by chip bbox. Buildings counted as inside a region when their centroid is within the region polygon. Area summed from each footprint's planar area at 13N.
data_source.providers: Microsoft + OpenStreetMap + Google + other partners (combined and deduplicated by Overture)
known_limitations: Updates quarterly; this release reflects data through approximately Q1 2026.
May still under-detect very recent informal construction.
Centroid-in-polygon test slightly miscounts buildings straddling a polygon edge.
Height metadata is sparse (mostly null) outside known dense urban cores.
